ideas.pitch: A vision-based autonomous rover capable of traversing rough mountainous terrain to locate stranded trekkers and deliver emergency medical supplies.
ideas.problem_statement: 01. Vision-Based Autonomous Robot: Build an autonomous robot that uses an AI-powered vision system to understand its surroundings, identify relevant objects and people, and navigate autonomously.
ideas.title: HimalayanRescueBot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges at a physical offline event in Manali will be heavily impressed by a hardware-meets-AI prototype that solves an actual geographic problem relevant to the Himalayas, rather than a generic simulator.

ideas.pitch: A fully onchain perpetual futures exchange featuring high-frequency funding rate updates calculated every block without any offchain relayers.
ideas.problem_statement: 02. Onchain Finance & Trading: Build a fully onchain financial product that leverages fast blockchain settlement to create innovative and transparent trading or lending markets.
ideas.title: PeakPerp
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the core challenge requirement of completely eliminating centralized offchain infrastructure, appealing directly to technical DeFi judges looking for pure smart contract architecture.

ideas.pitch: An undercollateralized lending protocol that evaluates user creditworthiness strictly based on verifiable onchain transaction history across multiple EVM chains.
ideas.problem_statement: 02. Onchain Finance & Trading: Build a fully onchain financial product that leverages fast blockchain settlement to create innovative and transparent trading or lending markets.
ideas.title: CredMountain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves one of the hardest practical problems in DeFi (undercollateralized lending) using transparent onchain analytics, making it a standout financial utility project.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed vision-language navigation assistant for rescue drones that interprets complex mountain weather and terrain obstacles in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: 01. Vision-Based Autonomous Robot: Build an autonomous robot that uses an AI-powered vision system to understand its surroundings, identify relevant objects and people, and navigate autonomously toward a given objective.
ideas.title: TrailFinderAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge vision-language models with embedded perception, directly addressing the sophisticated technical directions listed in the robotics problem statement.

ideas.pitch: A fully onchain order book matching engine settling trades directly on every block with deterministic liquidity pools.
ideas.problem_statement: 02. Onchain Finance & Trading: Build a fully onchain financial product that leverages fast blockchain settlement to create innovative and transparent trading or lending markets.
ideas.title: HimaBook
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific challenge track requirement for onchain order books with matching and settlement handled natively onchain.
